findings.text: the native-harness parameter here passes because launch_plan refuses every in-harness backend at reckon/_backends.py:1787 before images are ever read, so this parameter would stay green even if the figure-handling change were reverted; it guards the refusal-by-name contract but not the attachment, and only the claude and clive parameters exercise the image path.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified reckon/crew/dispatch.py as the production launcher that will supply figures to launch_plan; it does not yet pass a node's images, which the source manifest declares as a follow-on fenced to another node.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit ce5081a6 against base 1866e3b3; five paths, 302 insertions and no deletions, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_launch_plan_attaches_images.py with per-case assertions on launch_plan argv; the diff adds that file with eight cases; the manifest records the gate green.
item_verdicts.goal: the source goal is to make the launch plan the launcher runs carry a node's images or refuse them; reckon/_backends.py:1781 adds images to launch_plan and the codex dialect at line 1024 emits one -i flag per figure, while claude refuses at line 1328.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate green at 8 passed exit 0, the negative-control log path, and a base/after pair of runs over the affected selection.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares five paths; the manifest's diff of ce5081a6 against 1866e3b3 changes exactly those five.

justifications.durability: the declared negative control, the codex dialect ignoring its images argument, is recorded as reddening the flag-count assertion at tests/test_launch_plan_attaches_images.py:54 and raising for the resume-ordering case while the empty-tuple test stayed green, so the guard fires; independent assertions on flag count, pair order and resume order exist.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_launch_plan_attaches_images.py:54 reads the produced argv and the manifest records the gate green with its log, but the refusal test's native-harness parameter at line 100 reddens on a condition the image change does not touch, so that one parameter is not evidence about the attachment.
justifications.fit: reckon/_backends.py:1781 extends launch_plan with images in the surrounding kwargs idiom, the helpers _lane and _refuse_images are named by mechanism, and the codex comment at line 1022 explains why -i must precede resume; no banned name or plan identifier appears.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_backends.py:1024 appends an -i flag followed by the certificate per figure before the resume subcommand, and line 1328 raises by lane name, so the plan carries the figures or refuses; the launcher's own dispatch wiring is fenced to another node.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff ce5081a6 against 1866e3b3 changes exactly the five declared write paths with 302 insertions and no deletions; no path outside the fence appears in the diff stat.
